svg.title: Where the two sources date a stage boundary differently
svg.text: Two sources, one boundary: Railsback et al. against LR04
The beginning of 28 stages has a leading reading (Railsback et al. 2015) and an alternative one (LR04); both stay in the graph.
LR04 minus Railsback et al., ka
Stripes: warm stage (dots) and cold stage (hatching) as the vocabulary classes them. The boundary of a stage is the end of the one before it, so each is drawn once.
Neither reading is erased: the alternative one is a geolod:AlternativeAssignment next to the leading one.
